name: claude-viewer
description: A Claude Code terminal session as rich chat you can drive from the web: markdown and highlighted code, tool cards with diffs and screenshots, and every prompt the terminal asks (tool permissions, plan approval, folder trust, questions, pickers like /model) answered with a click. Mode, activity, context and cost in the toolbar, a push notification when Claude is waiting, and a live screen strip with a keypad for anything else. Open it from the chat icon on a window running Claude.

claudeViewer.pollInterval.description: How often (ms) the server reads each Claude window's screen, and how often an open tab fetches new transcript entries. With the app's agent hooks installed, a prompt shows immediately regardless of this.

claudeViewer.fontSize.description: Base font size (px) for the conversation: messages, tool cards and code. The toolbar and composer keep their own size.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
Enter starts a new line; Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on a Mac) sends.
claudeViewer.enterKey.description: What Enter does while writing a message or an answer.

claudeViewer.showUsageMeters.description: Show the 5-hour and 7-day plan usage meters in the toolbar. Off by default because Agent Usage Monitor already shows them in the status bar.

claudeViewer.showContext.description: Show the context used by the last turn and the estimated cost in the toolbar.

claudeViewer.pushNotifications.description: Send a push notification when Claude starts waiting on a prompt, to every browser subscribed to notifications in Settings.

claudeViewer.screenStripLines.description: How many lines of the terminal screen the screen strip shows.
